title: #426 Educational Games
prompt: What are the advantages and disadvantages of incorporating video games into education and skill development?

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Video games allow students to learn new subjects, such as history, by making the learning process enjoyable and engaging.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Video games allow students to learn new subjects, such as history, by making the learning process enjoyable and engaging.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Games enhance problem-solving skills because they require players to follow rules and complete tasks, improving critical thinking.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Games enhance problem-solving skills because they require players to follow rules and complete tasks, improving critical thinking.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Video games can consume excessive amounts of time, diverting students from necessary academic tasks like homework and reading.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Video games can consume excessive amounts of time, diverting students from necessary academic tasks like homework and reading.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Games may fail to teach appropriate subjects, focusing instead on entertainment and neglecting core academic skills.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Games may fail to teach appropriate subjects, focusing instead on entertainment and neglecting core academic skills.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Games can boost student engagement in learning.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Games can boost student engagement in learning.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Games help students develop important problem-solving skills.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Games help students develop important problem-solving skills.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Games can distract students from serious academic work.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Games can distract students from serious academic work.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The content of games may not match the required curriculum content.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The content of games may not match the required curriculum content.

modelPlan.focus: Explore the integration of video games in education by examining their advantages and disadvantages, supported by relevant vocabulary from A2 to C2 levels.
outline: body1: advantages of video games in education
body2: disadvantages of video games in education
keyArguments: Video games can serve as effective educational tools, promoting interactive learning and skill development.
However, over-reliance on video games may lead to potential drawbacks, such as reduced intrinsic motivation and cognitive load.
